data.narrative:
Valstad is a seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Dustin Walper that has raised $2.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 10 peers (2 public, 8 private) in the same sector and stage cohort, including Stark Defence, UFORCE, Castelion, Singularity, and NODA AI, alongside public references DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

Two methods support the valuation range. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement, using the $2.6M raised as a proxy base, yielding $6.5M. Peer-median analysis across the five sampled comps (ranging $125M to $4.0B in valuation) returns a median of $1.0B, reflecting heterogeneity in the peer set driven by stage mix—three Series A companies alongside one seed-stage peer at $1.0B.

The triangulation implies a range of $6M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $503M. The wide spread reflects material tension between stage-appropriate valuation anchors and peer multiples skewed by later-stage, higher-valuation comps. Key uncertainties include whether Valstad's technology differentiation and market position justify defense-sector premium valuations seen in peers like Stark Defence ($4.0B), and the relevance of the $1.0B seed-stage comp (UFORCE) as a true peer versus an outlier. Narrowing the range would require clarity on product maturity, customer traction, and competitive positioning within the sector.
